name: image-size
description: Stands in for `image-size` under the root `overrides`. pptxgenjs lists image-size for its Node-only file-path branch and excludes it from browser builds; every published image-size carries two unpatched HIGH advisories (GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq) that CI's audit refuses. The export runs in the browser and never reaches that branch, so the real package is replaced by this throwing stub. Drop it when image-size ships a fix.
